subject: Procedure division structure
notes: §14.2.3 GR7 (cite.py --check 14.2.3 "The initial value of the returning item, data-name-2, is undefined" -> OK §14.2.3 7)). Undefined behaviour imposes no requirement; the returning item binds as an ordinary LINKAGE item without a VALUE-driven initial state, and nothing observable can contradict it. No test can be spec-derived for an undefined value.
